dataset.name: EarthTwin curated analog catalogue
dataset.description: Curated catalogue of Earth analog candidate sites and Moon/Mars target regions: names, approximate coordinates, categories and qualitative context compiled by the team. Contains no measurements. Coordinates are approximate representative points and should be checked before field use.
dataset.provenance: Compiled by PLANEX from public sources listed in the citations. Qualitative context only.

earth_sites.name: McMurdo Dry Valleys
earth_sites.description: The largest ice-free region of Antarctica: a cold, hyper-arid polar desert with ice-cemented permafrost, patterned ground and perennially ice-covered lakes.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Granitic and metamorphic basement, Beacon Supergroup sedimentary rocks and Ferrar dolerite; glacial and periglacial deposits.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Long-term ecological research (McMurdo LTER) and repeated use as a cold-desert analog for Mars soils and ground ice.
limitations: Very remote; access only through national Antarctic programmes
future_work: Integrate MODIS land-surface temperature time series
Derive slope statistics from a high-resolution Antarctic DEM

earth_sites.name: Haughton Impact Structure
earth_sites.terrain_type: Impact structure in a polar desert
earth_sites.description: A well-preserved, roughly 23 km diameter impact structure in a high-Arctic polar desert with permafrost and periglacial landforms.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Impact breccias and impact-melt rocks emplaced in a Palaeozoic carbonate-dominated target sequence.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Host of the Haughton-Mars Project field research programme.
applications: Rover and EVA traverse tests in polar terrain
limitations: Carbonate target rocks differ from lunar/Martian basaltic crust
future_work: Import SRTM-gap-filled Arctic DEM terrain statistics
Map breccia units from published geological maps

earth_sites.name: Bockfjorden volcanic area
earth_sites.terrain_type: Glaciated Arctic valleys with volcanic centres
earth_sites.description: Arctic fjord landscape with Quaternary volcanic centres, warm springs, permafrost and glacial deposits.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Basaltic volcanic edifices with carbonate deposits, set in glacially eroded terrain.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Visited by the Arctic Mars Analog Svalbard Expedition (AMASE) field campaigns.
limitations: Vegetation and snow cover in places

earth_sites.name: Askja and Icelandic Highlands
earth_sites.terrain_type: Basaltic lava fields and tephra plains
earth_sites.description: Sparsely vegetated highland plateau with young basaltic lava flows, tephra deposits, calderas and glacio-volcanic landforms.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Basaltic volcanism on the Mid-Atlantic Ridge interacting with glacial ice.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Apollo astronauts carried out geology field training in the Askja region in the 1960s.
applications: Rover traverses on lava and tephra
limitations: Wet maritime climate compared with Moon/Mars
Seasonal access by road only in summer
future_work: Import ArcticDEM or national DEM terrain statistics

earth_sites.name: Raufarhólshellir lava tube
earth_sites.description: One of Iceland's longest lava tubes, formed in a postglacial basaltic lava flow; seasonal ice forms inside parts of the cave.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Pāhoehoe basalt flow field with collapse skylights.
limitations: Much smaller than candidate lunar lava tubes
Managed tourist cave: access restrictions apply
future_work: Add LiDAR-derived cave geometry if available

earth_sites.name: Mauna Kea upper slopes
earth_sites.description: Sparsely vegetated upper slopes of a shield volcano with cinder cones, tephra and fine basaltic regolith.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Basaltic to hawaiitic lavas and tephra; glacial deposits near the summit.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Used for in-situ resource utilisation field demonstrations (PISCES).
limitations: Culturally significant summit area with access restrictions

earth_sites.name: Craters of the Moon
earth_sites.description: Young basaltic lava flows, cinder cones and lava tubes on the Snake River Plain.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Holocene–late Pleistocene basaltic fissure eruptions along the Great Rift.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Apollo-era astronaut geology training; NASA volcanic-analog field research.

earth_sites.name: Lava Beds National Monument
earth_sites.description: Shield-volcano flank with hundreds of lava-tube caves, some containing perennial ice.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Basaltic flows of the Medicine Lake volcano.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Used for cave-robotics and subsurface-astrobiology analog research.
future_work: Import cave survey data as a map layer

earth_sites.name: Atacama Desert (Yungay)
earth_sites.description: Hyper-arid core of the Atacama Desert with extremely low rainfall and oxidising, salt-rich soils.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Alluvial and evaporite-bearing sediments with sulfates, nitrates and iron oxides.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Studied as a Mars-like soil environment and used for rover field tests.

earth_sites.name: Mars Desert Research Station area
earth_sites.description: Colourful layered sedimentary desert near Hanksville with mesas, washes and clay-rich badlands.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Jurassic–Cretaceous sandstones, mudstones and clay-bearing units.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Site of the Mars Society's Mars Desert Research Station crew simulations.
limitations: Sedimentary lithology differs from basaltic plains

earth_sites.name: Death Valley (Badwater Basin)
earth_sites.terrain_type: Hot desert basin with playas and alluvial fans
earth_sites.description: Below-sea-level desert basin with salt pans, alluvial fans and steep range fronts.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Evaporite playa deposits and alluvial fans in an extensional basin.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Named in the NASA Space Apps challenge statement as an established terrestrial analog.

earth_sites.name: Barringer Meteorite Crater
earth_sites.description: A young, well-preserved simple impact crater about 1.2 km across in a semi-arid plateau.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Ejecta and breccia from sandstone, limestone and siltstone target rocks.

earth_sites.name: Lonar Crater
earth_sites.description: A roughly 1.8 km simple impact crater formed in Deccan flood basalt, containing a saline alkaline lake.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Impact into basalt — a close lithological analog for craters on lunar maria.

earth_sites.name: Río Tinto
earth_sites.description: Acidic, iron- and sulfate-rich river system draining the Iberian Pyrite Belt.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Massive sulfide deposits; precipitation of iron oxides and sulfates such as jarosite.
earth_sites.analog_heritage: Site of the MARTE robotic drilling experiment.

earth_sites.name: Las Cañadas del Teide
earth_sites.description: High-altitude caldera with basaltic and phonolitic lava flows and pumice fields.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Ocean-island volcanism; basaltic to phonolitic compositions.

earth_sites.name: Namib gravel plains
earth_sites.description: Extensive flat gravel plains and dune margins in a fog-influenced coastal desert.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Gravel lags over granitic and metamorphic basement; aeolian sand.
applications: Landing-terrain and mobility trials on flat gravel

earth_sites.name: Dallol, Danakil Depression
earth_sites.description: Hot, below-sea-level salt plain with acidic hydrothermal springs and colourful sulfur/iron deposits.
earth_sites.geologic_context: Thick evaporite sequences over an active rift; hydrothermal iron oxides and sulfates.

target_regions.name: Shackleton crater rim, lunar south pole
target_regions.description: Crater rim near the lunar south pole with near-continuous illumination on parts of the rim and permanently shadowed regions inside the crater.
target_regions.geologic_context: Anorthositic highland crust; impact-generated regolith; volatiles indicated in permanently shadowed cold traps.
target_regions.mission_relevance: South-polar region targeted for crewed exploration and a long-term lunar presence.

target_regions.name: Mare Tranquillitatis (Apollo 11 site)
target_regions.description: Smooth basaltic mare plain; landing site of Apollo 11.
target_regions.geologic_context: Titanium-rich mare basalts covered by fine regolith.
target_regions.mission_relevance: Reference for landing on smooth, low-slope basaltic plains.

target_regions.name: Marius Hills skylight
target_regions.region_type: Volcanic dome field with pit crater
target_regions.description: Volcanic dome field containing a pit interpreted as a skylight into a lava tube.
target_regions.geologic_context: Mare basalts and volcanic domes; sinuous rilles.
target_regions.mission_relevance: Candidate natural shelter for habitats (lava tube).

target_regions.name: Hadley Rille (Apollo 15 site)
target_regions.description: Mare plain at the foot of the Apennine Mountains cut by the sinuous Hadley Rille; landing site of Apollo 15.
target_regions.geologic_context: Mare basalts adjacent to highland massifs; rille interpreted as a volcanic lava channel.
target_regions.mission_relevance: Reference for mixed mare/highland geology and rugged terrain.

target_regions.name: Jezero crater
target_regions.description: Crater that once held a lake, with a well-preserved delta; landing site of the Perseverance rover.
target_regions.geologic_context: Olivine-rich and basaltic units, clay- and carbonate-bearing deltaic sediments.

target_regions.name: Gale crater
target_regions.description: Large crater containing Aeolis Mons (Mount Sharp); landing site of the Curiosity rover.
target_regions.geologic_context: Lacustrine mudstones, clay- and sulfate-bearing strata, aeolian sands.

target_regions.name: Arcadia Planitia (mid-latitude ice plains)
target_regions.region_type: Mid-latitude volcanic plains with shallow ice
target_regions.description: Smooth northern plains where shallow subsurface excess ice has been inferred from radar and crater morphology.
target_regions.geologic_context: Volcanic plains mantled by ice-rich deposits.
target_regions.mission_relevance: Candidate region for crewed landing with accessible water ice.

target_regions.name: Elysium Planitia (InSight site)
target_regions.description: Very smooth, low-slope volcanic plain chosen for safe landing; landing site of the InSight lander.
target_regions.geologic_context: Hesperian–Amazonian lava plains with fine regolith.
target_regions.mission_relevance: Reference for flat, low-rock-abundance landing terrain.

target_regions.name: Utopia Planitia (Zhurong site)
target_regions.description: Southern Utopia Planitia, landing area of China's Zhurong rover.
target_regions.geologic_context: Northern lowland plains with possible sedimentary and volcanic units.
